title: ID0442057-DC/SI-D/FR-[Y2 / PD 312571675/25]touchscreen is performing very poorly
description:
Reported issue:
The charger is equipped with a new modular screen.
However, the touchscreen is performing very poorly.
It doesn’t respond consistently, and when it does, the touch
detection is inaccurate — the screen reacts in a different area than
where you actually press.
I’ve carried out multiple tests, and in 9 out of 10 cases, the screen
fails to respond.
Please schedule an intervention as soon as possible to resolve the
issue
Solution: NA

additional_info.body:
Dear Colleagues,
Please verify the most recent firmware for the D-logic controller. Ascertain whether FC-12 in the automation area has tripped. Examine all wiring associated with the HMI and D-logic controller.
Make sure the PCB is firmly connected during update and handle it with extra care as they are prone to damage with any push and pull force to the flat ribbon cable.
Refer :
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SICD_HW_Screen Upside Down_HMI Touch Repsonse - Dynamics 365
